narrative.northStar: Deep indigo, restrained gold, readable working surfaces
narrative.overview: Implemented web UI based on the user-approved B direction: indigo surfaces, restrained gold, a horizontal application frame, and direct task copy. AppHeader and AppView share the frame; HomePage provides a four-row directory. Glamour and teleport share the same fullscreen AuthenticationGate, with LoginDialog above it and innermost Escape handling. Feature-local styles use semantic variables; compatibility aliases remain for inline consumers. Local font fallbacks are not bundled fonts.
keyCharacteristics: Identical fullscreen authentication barriers for protected workspaces

rules.name: The boundary rule
rules.body: Use control-line for functional input boundaries; line is for nonessential dividers.

rules.name: The state rule
rules.body: Pair semantic colors with specific text and a structural cue where appropriate.

dos: Keep both themes on the same semantic aliases.
Preserve game data and task-specific information density.
Cover the entire viewport, including navigation, while glamour or teleport is gated; return home on barrier dismissal.
donts: Do not bring slogans or themed module names into UI copy.
Do not treat generated emblems as approved brand assets.
Do not treat synthetic fixture screenshots or web checks as native Windows bridge or authenticated-service verification.
